notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Bristly Bill by paying {3}{G}{G}, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
If Crystalline Crawler has six or more +1/+1 counters on it to start the combo, this combo results in infinite colored mana.
